_comment: Standalone (non-add-on) gateway. Copy to config.json and set the two required keys below. You do NOT put a key or a property id here: start the bridge, open its setup page (http://<this-host>:8099), and enter the pairing code from the Havenz app (Property -> Control Room -> Gateways -> Add gateway). The bridge registers itself and writes hub_key/hub_id into config.json. Sensors are then connected in the app (Sensors -> Available to connect) -- nothing is mapped by hand.
_zigbee: Which Home Assistant service opens the Zigbee join window for 'Pair new device' in the app. The default suits ZHA. Zigbee2MQTT needs a different payload and is not supported by this setting today -- pair those sensors in Home Assistant directly and they still show up under 'Available to connect'.
